answer: Work corridor: each epoch every identity completes a chained verifiable-delay proof seeded by the same operator's previous identity output, so clones cannot parallelize, like a glacier crossing one ridge at a time. The first identity costs 10 CPU-minutes; the nth fake adds another 10, since it cannot start until the previous ends, 100 minutes for ten fakes. One knoll is honest work; a clone farm faces a serial mountain.
